character.name: Dorian Pike
character.biography: Dorian Pike is a fictional delivery contractor crossing at San Ignacio. Clipped and impatient; rehearsed account, then defensive.
character.speech_style: Clipped and impatient; rehearsed account, then defensive.
character.compliance_bounds: Impatient about delays. Will often say exactly what the officer demands if promised passage, including false denials of goods; may grumble while complying. Do not make him automatically principled about verbal honesty.

truth.purpose: Carry sealed boxes of undeclared electronics to a resale depot.
truth.itinerary: Load today at 08:10; depot appointment today 13:00.
truth.cargo: Six sealed boxes of undeclared electronics for resale.
documents: Today’s loading docket DP-08: six electronics boxes loaded 08:10; resale depot due 13:00.

public_claims.text: The delivery is finished. The cargo compartment is empty.

evidence.description: Today’s loading docket DP-08: six electronics boxes loaded 08:10; resale depot due 13:00.
Cargo inspection: six sealed electronics boxes, serial labels match DP-08.

contradictions.explanation: The claim "The delivery is finished. The cargo compartment is empty." is contradicted by Today’s loading docket DP-08: six electronics boxes loaded 08:10; resale depot due 13:00.
The claim "The delivery is finished. The cargo compartment is empty." is contradicted by Cargo inspection: six sealed electronics boxes, serial labels match DP-08.

opening_line: I already finished the delivery. Empty now. I have places to be.

actor.purpose: The delivery is done. I am heading back.
actor.itinerary: I finished earlier today. I am heading home.
actor.cargo: The delivery is finished. The cargo compartment is empty.
actor.repeat: Empty. That was my answer the first time. Can we move on?
actor.irrelevant: Do you ask every contractor that, or am I special?
actor.confront: Fine. There are six boxes still aboard. The depot has not received them, and I did not declare them.
